Question: What is the minimum attendance percentage required to write semester exams, and what happens if I am in the 80% to 89% range?
Common Student Phrasings: "minimum attendance percentage sathyabama", "attendance required for sem exam", "can i write exam with 85% attendance", "what is condonation fee attendance sathyabama"
Answer: Sathyabama requires a minimum of 90% attendance in each course to be automatically eligible for End Semester Examinations. If your attendance falls between 80% and 89% due to genuine medical illness or official university on-duty (OD), you may be granted condonation upon Dean approval and payment of the condonation fee. Attendance below 80% strictly disqualifies you from writing the exam and requires repeating the course.
Verified Authority: Official Sathyabama Academic Regulations & Student Handbook 2026-2027
Validity: 2027-06-30
Keywords: attendance, condonation, 90 percent, medical leave, exams, eligibility

Question: What are the college bus arrival and departure timings for regular days and special training?
Common Student Phrasings: "what time do college buses leave sathyabama", "morning bus arrival time", "placement bus timing 5pm", "day scholar bus schedule"

Question: What is the weightage split between Continuous Assessment (CAE) and End Semester Exams, and how many marks are needed to pass?
Common Student Phrasings: "cae marks weightage sathyabama", "how are internal marks calculated", "how many marks to pass end sem", "pass mark out of 100 sathyabama"
Answer: Theory courses are split 50% for Continuous Assessment Exams (CAE 1 and CAE 2) and 50% for the University End Semester Examination. To pass, you must score at least 50% in the End Semester Examination itself, AND achieve at least 50% total aggregate when combining CAE and End Semester marks.
Verified Authority: Controller of Examinations (COE) Evaluation Regulations
Validity: 2027-06-30
Keywords: cae, internal marks, pass mark, 50 percent, coe, grading

Question: If I already have a job offer, can I sit for higher CTC Dream or Super Dream companies?
Common Student Phrasings: "can i attend placements after getting placed", "dream offer upgrade criteria sathyabama", "super dream company eligibility", "minimum package hike to sit for next company"
Answer: Yes, under the CDC Upgrade Policy: A student holding an offer up to 5 LPA can attend a Dream Company drive (5 to 10 LPA) only if the new package offers at least a 1.5 LPA hike over the existing CTC. To sit for a Super Dream Company (>10 LPA), the new package must offer at least a 3.0 LPA hike over the current CTC. In all cases, 90% attendance in placement training is mandatory.
Verified Authority: Centre for Career Guidance and Development (CDC)
Validity: 2027-06-30
Keywords: placements, cdc, dream offer, super dream, upgrade policy, ctc
